title: Sensitivity labels and endorsement: promote, certify, label inheritance
objective_text: Choose who can promote and certify items, and predict how a sensitivity label flows to the items built from a labelled one.
scenario: Governance wants trusted lakehouses marked and confidential data labelled from source to report. The team needs to know who may do what, and where labels end up on their own.
verifies: You can pick the right feature, setting or operator for each scenario, with the reason and source shown afterwards.
does_not_verify: That you can do it in Fabric: nothing is set up or run here. Doing it on a real item is FABRIC VERIFIED work.
